title.en: COVID-19 (Temporary Measures) (Extension of Prescribed Period) (No. 2) Order 2020

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the COVID‑19 (Temporary Measures) (Extension of Prescribed Period) (No. 2) Order 2020.

heading.en: Extension of prescribed period for Part 1 of Act

text.en: 2. The prescribed period as it applies to Part 1 of the Act is extended by a period starting on 20 November 2020 and ending on 31 March 2021.

heading.en: Extension of prescribed period for Part 2 of Act
